edit.description: renderSchemaForPrompt: extensionLines separator uses indexOf('//') — first '//' anywhere in the line, not a real trailing comment marker; corrupts a hint whose own text contains '//' (e.g. a URL)
add a renderSchemaForPrompt case for a hint containing '//' as content with no trailing comment, and one with both a URL and a genuine trailing comment

summary: 9f4e62f's separator fix matches the first '//' in the line; a hint containing '//' as content (e.g. a URL) gets its comma spliced mid-string and the remainder misread as a comment

per.section: 2. Entry schema splits: engine core + chain-declared extension

tests.asserts: a hint like '"https://example.com/hooks"' (no trailing comment) renders intact with its separator appended after the full hint, not spliced at the URL's '//'; a hint with both a URL and a genuine trailing ' // comment' still splits at the real comment

acceptance: renderSchemaForPrompt distinguishes a genuine trailing line comment from '//' occurring inside a hint's own text; reproduced today via a webhook-style hint — 'https:,  //example.com/hooks' — must no longer occur
notes: Repro: render({webhook:{hint:'"https://example.com/hooks/notify"'}, notes:{hint:'"..."'}}) currently yields '"webhook": "https:,  //example.com/hooks/notify"'. A last-index-of-' // ' (space-slash-slash-space) heuristic would distinguish real trailing comments from in-string '//' without a leading space.
